research_rationale:
EO 12642 (53 FR 21975) of June 8, 1988 designates the Secretary of Defense as the Presidential designee under Title I of the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act and authorizes delegation within the Department of Defense. The held original was read in full and confirmed to be the order (title, date and subject agree with the register row). Both sections are standing commands with no own-terms end; no held later instrument amends, revokes or supersedes the order, and the three bounded searches show citations of the order as current authority and no ending statement. Both clauses are carried as operative through 2026-10-14.
